questions.stem_text:
Supposing that theclonalselection theory is correct, how canan organism genetically make
such diverse proteins?

options.A: Through vertical gene transfer from parent to offspring
options.B: Through random assortment of genes during meiosis
options.C: Through peptide bond formation errors during translation
options.E: Through transcriptional errors in RNA processing

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Through vertical gene transfer from parent to offspring

questions.stem_text: Convergent evolution is best exemplified by which of the following?

options.A: The gills of a fish and the lungs of a human
options.B: The leaves of an oak tree and the spines of a cactus
options.C: The eyes of a human and the eyes of a squid
options.D: The roots of a tree and the legs of an animal
options.E: The presence of a notochord in all chordate embryos

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The gills of a fish and the lungs of a human

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following pieces of evidence most strongly supports the common origin of all
life on Earth?

options.B: All organisms are capable of evolving.
options.E: All organisms are composed of cells.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - All organisms reproduce.

questions.stem_text: What function does oxygen serve in the body?

options.A: Oxygen is used to maintain the temperature of cells.
options.B: Oxygen is used by cells to produce alcohol.
options.C: Oxygen is used to produce carbon dioxide in cells.
options.D: Oxygen is solely responsible for stimulating brain activity.
options.E: Oxygen is used to synthesize proteins in cells.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Oxygen is used to maintain the temperature of cells.

questions.stem_text: What are some of the cues used by animal in migrating?

options.A: Animals use the temperature changes as cues.
options.B: Animals use the color of the surroundings as cues.
options.C: Animals use the noises from the environment as cues.
options.D: Animals navigate by following other migrating animal species exclusively.
options.E: Animals rely solely on the memory of previous migration paths.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Animals use the temperature changes as cues.
